mentions.name: Collaborative post-apocalyptic fitness RPG
mentions.description: A collaborative post-apocalyptic fitness RPG for iPhone (with the best experience on Apple Watch) that encourages players to get off the couch and take over the real world, designed so all multiplayer engagement is positive. When players find or invite another player nearby, all their shared actions benefit both of them. It is very early and playable via TestFlight with feedback welcomed.
mentions.problem: Getting people off the couch and moving in the real world.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a collaborative post-apocalyptic fitness RPG. I wanted to build a game that lets you take over the real world, gets you off the couch, and has only positive multiplayer engagement. If you find or invite another player nearby, all your actions with them benefit you both.
mentions.author: Schiendelman
